constants.constants.hint.border.apply: Line style / width / color apply immediately; these three rows show the effective spec. With an existing border, changing any row fills all four sides and clears per-side overrides. Top / right / bottom / left add a border only to the selected side; removing one turns the other three into per-side borders. "None" clears the border; "Inside" is available for table cells only.
constants.constants.hint.border.pending: Line style / width / color are a pending spec: they are prefilled when the selected cells share one border spec. Mixed values show "Mixed"; no border shows "None / 0". Click All / Outside / Inside or tick a side (top / right / bottom / left) to write to the selected cells; "None" clears the border.
constants.constants.hint.border.multi: Multi-select does not show a single cell border: line style / width / color act as a batch spec. Click All / Outside / Inside or tick a side to apply to all selected cells; "None" clears the border.
constants.constants.hint.border.mixed: The four sides of this cell have different border specs: "Mixed" is shown instead of a false value. Untouched fields fall back to the default (Solid 0.75pt) when you click All / Outside / Inside or tick a side; changing any field writes that value to the batch.
